b8.zh: T 方快攻占 14%，低于其他队伍的 28%。T 方最常用一道烟、二道烟和 B点柱子火爆弹 B 点，7 次赢下 7 次。
b8.en: Fast hits account for 14% of T gun rounds versus 28% for other teams. The go-to B execute uses B short smoke, B long smoke and a B pillar molotov, winning 7 of 7 attempts.

betboom.zh: T 方快攻占 46%，高于其他队伍的 26%。T 方最常用警家烟和靠墓地的 A后点火爆弹 A 点，6 次赢下 3 次。
betboom.en: Fast hits account for 46% of T gun rounds versus 26% for other teams. The go-to A execute uses CT smoke and a Back A molotov on the Temple side, winning 3 of 6 attempts.

falcons.zh: Falcons 的 T 方最常用 A 点爆弹，以警家烟、A后点火（靠墓地）配合，4 次进攻赢下 1 次。CT 默认站位 A1 M2 B2 占 27% 的枪局，胜率 67%。
falcons.en: Falcons' T side favors an A execute with CT smoke and Back A molotov (Temple side), winning 1 of 4 attempts. The default CT setup A1 M2 B2 covers 27% of gun rounds with a 67% win rate.

fut-esports.zh: T 方最常用一道烟、二道烟和 B点柱子火爆弹 B 点，7 次赢下 6 次。T 方最常由 Krabeni 摸边，5 次进攻时他在另一侧或远离进攻点。
fut-esports.en: The go-to B execute uses B short smoke, B long smoke and a B pillar molotov, winning 6 of 7 attempts. Krabeni is the usual T lurker, on the other side or far from the hit on 5 attacks.

g2.zh: T 方最常用一道烟、二道烟和 B点柱子火爆弹 B 点，6 次赢下 0 次。T 方最常由 MATYS 摸边，4 次进攻时他在另一侧或远离进攻点。
g2.en: The go-to B execute uses B short smoke, B long smoke and a B pillar molotov, winning 0 of 6 attempts. MATYS is the usual T lurker, on the other side or far from the hit on 4 attacks.

gamerlegion.zh: GamerLegion 的 CT 方堆点防守占 30%，高于其他队伍的 7%。默认站位 A2 B3 占 26% 的枪局，胜率 50%，更常集中人手守点。
gamerlegion.en: GamerLegion's CT side stacks in 30% of rounds versus the other teams' 7%, more often concentrating defenders at a site. Its default setup A2 B3 covers 26% of gun rounds with a 50% win rate.

legacy.zh: T 方分兵进点占 19%，低于其他队伍的 46%。T 方最常由 latto 摸边，7 次进攻时他在另一侧或远离进攻点。
legacy.en: The T side uses split hits on 19% of attacks versus 46% for other teams. latto is the usual T lurker, on the other side or far from the hit on 7 attacks.

lgcy.zh: T 方最常用一道烟、二道烟和 B点柱子火爆弹 B 点，5 次赢下 5 次。开局 20 秒的 CT 默认站位为 A2 B3，占 31% 的枪局，胜率 57%。
lgcy.en: The go-to B execute uses B short smoke, B long smoke and a B pillar molotov, winning 5 of 5 attempts. At 20 s, the default CT setup is A2 B3, used in 31% of gun rounds with a win rate of 57%.

lvg.zh: T 方最常用一道烟、二道烟和 B点柱子火爆弹 B 点，4 次赢下 2 次。CT 堆点防守占 25%，高于其他队伍的 7%。
lvg.en: The go-to B execute uses B short smoke, B long smoke and a B pillar molotov, winning 2 of 4 attempts. The CT side stacks a site in 25% of gun rounds versus 7% for other teams.

m80.zh: T 方有人摸边的进攻占 55%，高于其他队伍的 36%。进攻开始后 CT 及时回防占 78%，高于其他队伍的 55%。
m80.en: The T side includes a lurker on 55% of hits versus 36% for other teams. CT rotations arrive in time in 78% of rounds versus 55% for other teams.

mibr.zh: T 方有人摸边的进攻占 58%，高于其他队伍的 36%。T 方最常用警家烟和靠墓地的 A后点火爆弹 A 点，6 次赢下 3 次。
mibr.en: The T side includes a lurker on 58% of hits versus 36% for other teams. The go-to A execute uses CT smoke and a Back A molotov on the Temple side, winning 3 of 6 attempts.

ninjas-in-pyjamas.zh: T 方分兵进点占 73%，高于其他队伍的 45%。
ninjas-in-pyjamas.en: The T side uses split hits on 73% of attacks versus 45% for other teams.

nrg.zh: NRG 的 T 方最常用 B 点爆弹，以二道烟、一道火（深）配合，4 次进攻赢下 3 次。
nrg.en: NRG's T side favors a B execute with B long smoke and B short molotov (deep), winning 3 of 4 attempts.

parivision.zh: T 方有人摸边的进攻占 56%，高于其他队伍的 36%。T 方最常用警家烟和甜甜圈出口烟爆弹 A 点，5 次赢下 1 次。
parivision.en: The T side includes a lurker on 56% of hits versus 36% for other teams. The go-to A execute uses CT smoke and Donut exit smoke, winning 1 of 5 attempts.

sinners.zh: SINNERS 的 T 方最常由 kisserek 摸边，4 次进攻时他在另一侧或远离进攻点。
sinners.en: SINNERS' T side usually has kisserek lurking, with him on the other side or away from the hit on 4 attacks.

spirit.zh: T 方最常用警家烟和靠墓地的 A后点火爆弹 A 点，4 次赢下 2 次。
spirit.en: The go-to A execute uses CT smoke and a Back A molotov on the Temple side, winning 2 of 4 attempts.

the-mongolz.zh: The MongolZ 的 T 方最常用 B 点爆弹，以一道烟、二道烟、B点柱子火配合，4 次进攻赢下 3 次。
the-mongolz.en: The MongolZ's T side favors a B execute with B short smoke, B long smoke and B pillar molotov, winning 3 of 4 attempts.

tyloo.zh: T 方最常用一道烟、二道烟和 B点柱子火爆弹 B 点，8 次赢下 5 次。
tyloo.en: The go-to B execute uses B short smoke, B long smoke and a B pillar molotov, winning 5 of 8 attempts.
